title: Commit Field
description: A causal backtest: three stigmergic heat models replayed over real git history and scored on whether they predict the files each next commit actually touched.

cogdoc.claim: On this corpus, diffusing co-change heat adds no next-file prediction over recency (field - recency = -0.0005 MRR, 95% CI [-0.0021, +0.0012]); recency beats frequency. Against a like-for-like random baseline frequency is 9.2x, so the declared 'all three > 10x random' fails for frequency.

changes: Random baseline averaged per target like the models (sum k*H_N/N / sum k), in both extract.py (1.1.0) and the in-browser port; results.json/manifest.json regenerated from the pinned cogos commit 6a8ad3857e (events.json byte-identical). random MRR 0.00755 -> 0.00824; ratios frequency 10.04x -> 9.19x, recency 13.6x -> 12.5x, field 13.6x -> 12.4x. Prediction 3 now shows failed for frequency; reconciliation still delta 0 on all four rows.

Claim adds the paired bootstrap CI for field - recency ([-0.0021, +0.0012], 2000 resamples of 627 commits). 'Pre-registered before the first run' -> 'declared in the shipped page; not independently timestamped'. Badge text says only that the two ports agree.
Limitation 4 corrected (renames split a file's history; they are not followed). Speed knob relabelled (it is changes per frame, not per second). UI wording per wording.md 3.7.
